nav.noEntities: No data types cached for this site. Open Sites and use “Test connection” or refresh the schema while online.

top.offlineHint: No network. Everything keeps working locally.
top.syncSoon: The sync engine arrives in the next release

sites.title: WordPress sites
sites.none: No sites yet. Add your first WordPress site to begin.
sites.name: Display name
sites.keepPassword: (leave empty to keep the saved one)
sites.keychainNote: The Application Password is stored only in your operating system's secure credential store (keychain), never in the database or any file.
sites.webNote: Browser preview mode: the password is kept for this tab session only. Use the desktop app for keychain storage.
sites.offlineNote: You are offline. You can save the site now and test the connection later.
sites.accessible: {{count}} data types available to this user
sites.noPassword: No Application Password is available. Enter it and try again.
sites.confirmRemove: Remove “{{name}}” and delete its local data? Its Application Password is removed from the keychain.
sites.confirmRemovePending: “{{name}}” has {{count}} pending change(s) that were never synced. Removing it deletes them permanently. Continue?

err.notInstalled: This site does not have the Pressdock Connector plugin. Install and activate “Pressdock Connector” from WordPress.org (Plugins → Add New), then test again.
err.auth: WordPress rejected the username or Application Password. Create a new Application Password under Users → Profile.
err.forbidden: This user is not allowed to use Pressdock on this site.
err.insecure: The Connector requires HTTPS. Use an https:// address (or enable HTTP for local development hosts in Tools → Pressdock).
err.timeout: The site did not answer in time.

grid.confirmDelete: Delete {{count}} record(s)? They are marked deleted locally and removed from the site on the next sync.

form.deletedNotice: This record is deleted locally and waits for the next sync.

validation.datetime: Enter a valid date and time
validation.enum: Choose one of the allowed values
validation.media: Enter an attachment ID or choose a file
validation.list: Must be a list of text items

settings.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
settings.installUpdate: Download and install version {{v}} now? The app will restart.

about.tagline: Manage your WordPress plugin data offline-first, from your desktop.

sync.needsConfirm: Changes (deletes or more than 20) are waiting. Press Sync to review and confirm.
sync.summary: Sync done — pushed {{pushed}}, pulled {{pulled}}, conflicts {{conflicts}}, errors {{errors}}
sync.previewIntro: About to send {{creates}} new, {{updates}} edited and {{deletes}} deleted record(s) to the site.
sync.deleteNote: Deleted records are moved to the trash on the site where WordPress supports it. An admin can undo a whole batch from Sync history.

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.pick: Pick a conflict on the left to compare local and server versions.
conflicts.resolved: Conflict resolved — the result will be sent on the next sync
conflicts.msgServerDeleted: This record was deleted on the site, but you edited it here.
conflicts.msgLocalDeleted: You deleted this record here, but it was changed on the site.

history.title: Sync history
history.confirmUndo: Undo this batch on the site? Changes made on the site after this sync are overwritten. Administrators only.
history.adminOnly: Only WordPress administrators can undo a batch.

import.title: Import data
import.drop: Drop a CSV / XLSX file here, or click to choose
import.emptyFile: The file has no data rows.

modes.createHint: Every row becomes a new record.
modes.updateHint: Rows must match an existing record; others are errors.
modes.upsertHint: Update when a match exists, otherwise create.

import.matchUnmapped: Map a file column to this field first.
import.unmappedRequired: Required fields not mapped (new records will be invalid): {{fields}}
import.relationsHint: How should values in relation columns find their record?
import.skipInvalid: Skip the {{count}} invalid row(s) and import the rest
import.localOnly: Nothing is sent to the site yet. Imported rows become pending changes and upload on the next sync.

err.ambiguous: “{{value}}” matches {{count}} related records — use an ID or a unique field
err.duplicateInFile: Same record appears twice in the file
err.matchedConflict: Matched record has an unresolved conflict

warn.unknownId: ID {{value}} not found locally (will be checked on sync)

bulk.localOnly: Changes are saved locally and upload on the next sync.
bulk.deleteSynced: {{count}} of these exist on the site and will be removed there on the next sync (you can undo a sync from History).
